traceability.notes:
docs/stories/006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION.story.md defines a story-file reference validation rule with detailed path, security, boundary, configurability, and error-handling requirements. The implementation is in src/rules/valid-story-reference.ts with helpers in src/rules/helpers/valid-story-reference-helpers.ts and shared utilities in src/utils/storyReferenceUtils.ts. These files include explicit @story/@req/@supports annotations tying the code back to this story’s REQs.
The rule validates that @story annotations reference existing .story.md files, enforces extension when configured, resolves paths via cwd and configurable storyDirectories, prevents traversal and out-of-project access, and differentiates missing files from filesystem errors. Robust error handling and caching are implemented. Tests in tests/rules/valid-story-reference.test.ts comprehensively cover core behavior, configuration, project boundary behavior, and filesystem error scenarios, and they all passed in the latest Jest run. Documentation in docs/rules/valid-story-reference.md matches the implemented behavior. All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for this story are satisfied with concrete evidence.
